name: IdeaSoft
description: IdeaSoft Admin API for your own IdeaSoft shop: orders with lines, notes and shipments, products with stock, prices and descriptions, categories, brands, customers, refund requests, payment types and currencies. OAuth2 sign-in with the shop's own API client.
instructions:
## IdeaSoft
This connector works with the **IdeaSoft Admin API** of your own IdeaSoft shop (the Turkish e-commerce platform), at `https://<your shop domain>/admin-api`: orders with their lines, notes and shipments, products with stock, prices and descriptions, categories, brands, customers, refund requests, payment types and currencies.

**Setup (about 5 minutes, account owner only)**
1. Sign in to the IdeaSoft admin panel as the account owner (only the first admin user sees the API section; your package must include API access).
2. Open **Entegrasyonlar > API** and click **API Ekle**. Enter a name and, as **Redirect URL**, exactly `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback` on AnythingMCP Cloud (self-hosted: `<your AnythingMCP URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback`). Save: IdeaSoft creates the **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.
3. On that row open **İzin Yönetimi > İzin ekle** and give the areas you need Okuma (read) or Okuma/Yazma (read and write): orders, products, categories, brands, members, shipping, payments. Without permissions the client does not work.
4. Put your shop's host into `IDEASOFT_SHOP_DOMAIN` (e.g. `magaza.myideasoft.com` or your own domain, without https://), and the client id and secret into `IDEASOFT_CLIENT_ID` and `IDEASOFT_CLIENT_SECRET`.
5. Install, click **Authorize with Provider**, approve the app in the IdeaSoft panel, then run `ideasoft_list_products`.

The access token lasts 24 hours and is renewed automatically; the refresh token lasts about two months and changes at every renewal. After two months without any use, authorize again.

**Where to start**: `ideasoft_list_orders` with `sort` -id for the newest orders (status waiting_for_approval or approved for the ones to handle), then `ideasoft_get_order`. `ideasoft_list_products` and `ideasoft_get_product` for the catalogue.

**Orders**: `ideasoft_list_orders`, `ideasoft_count_orders`, `ideasoft_get_order`, `ideasoft_list_order_items`, `ideasoft_list_order_details` (custom checkout fields), `ideasoft_list_order_notes` and `ideasoft_add_order_note` (admin notes). Move an order on with `ideasoft_update_order` (being_prepared, fulfilled for shipped, delivered). Writing the tracking code through it is in IdeaSoft's schema but not documented as writable: check the order afterwards. `ideasoft_cancel_order` (cancelled or refunded) is installed switched off.

**Shipping**: `ideasoft_list_shipments` and `ideasoft_get_shipment` read tracking codes, barcodes and waybills; `ideasoft_list_shipping_providers` and `ideasoft_list_shipping_companies` list the carriers. Creating shipments and generating carrier tracking codes through the admin API is not included: IdeaSoft documents those actions without a body or meaning.

**Products**: `ideasoft_list_products` (filters for stock, status, brand, category, price), `ideasoft_count_products`, `ideasoft_get_product`, `ideasoft_create_product` and `ideasoft_update_product` (stock_amount for stock, price1 for the main price). Variants are child products (filter by parent). Extra price lists 2 to 6: `ideasoft_list_product_prices` and `ideasoft_update_product_price`. Long HTML descriptions: `ideasoft_list_product_details` and `ideasoft_update_product_details`. `ideasoft_delete_product` is switched off; set status 0 to hide a product. Lookups: `ideasoft_list_categories`, `ideasoft_get_category`, `ideasoft_list_brands`, `ideasoft_get_brand`, `ideasoft_list_currencies` (ids for currency) and `ideasoft_list_payment_types`.

**Customers and refunds**: `ideasoft_list_members` and `ideasoft_get_member` (the answer includes a hashed password field: never repeat it). `ideasoft_list_refund_requests`, `ideasoft_count_refund_requests` and `ideasoft_get_refund_request`; `ideasoft_update_refund_request` approves or cancels a request and is switched off, because approving can pay the customer back.

**Reading the data**: lists answer a bare JSON array; page with `page` and `limit` (at most 100, more answers 400) and stop when a page is empty. `since_id` with sort `id` is the safest incremental sync. Date filters take YYYY-MM-DD; answers carry Turkey time (`+03:00`). Prices are decimals in the product currency. IdeaSoft's write schemas list read-only fields as required; this connector sends only the fields you give, which IdeaSoft's documentation does not confirm for every resource: on a 400 or 422 read the record and send the fields named in the error.

**Limits and errors**: the rate limit is dynamic; a 429 means wait briefly and retry. 401 means the token is missing or expired (authorize again), 403 that the API entry lacks the permission for this area, 422 a validation error.

**Writes: confirm first.** Stock, prices, order status, notes and product data act on the live shop. Before each call show the user what changes and wait for a yes.

IDEASOFT_SHOP_DOMAIN.label: Shop domain
IDEASOFT_SHOP_DOMAIN.help: The host of your IdeaSoft shop without https:// and without a path: the magaza.myideasoft.com address or your own domain.
IDEASOFT_SHOP_DOMAIN.patternMessage: Only the host, e.g. magaza.myideasoft.com or www.example.com.tr, without https:// or a path.

IDEASOFT_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID
IDEASOFT_CLIENT_ID.help: Admin panel > Entegrasyonlar > API: the Client ID of the API entry you created with the AnythingMCP redirect URL.
IDEASOFT_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: Paste the Client ID alone, without spaces.

IDEASOFT_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Client Secret
IDEASOFT_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Same row: the Client Secret. Give the entry permissions under İzin Yönetimi, or it will not work.
IDEASOFT_CLIENT_SECRET.patternMessage: Paste the Client Secret alone, without spaces.

verifyHints.401: IdeaSoft refused the token. Authorize again with Authorize with Provider; after two months without use the refresh token expires. Check that the client id and secret belong to this shop.
verifyHints.403: The API entry has no permission for this area. In the IdeaSoft panel open Entegrasyonlar > API > İzin Yönetimi and add Okuma or Okuma/Yazma for it, then authorize again.
verifyHints.404: IdeaSoft found no record with that id, or IDEASOFT_SHOP_DOMAIN is not the shop's host.
verifyHints.rate_limited: IdeaSoft limits requests dynamically. Wait a few seconds and try again.

prerequisites: An IdeaSoft shop whose package includes API access, signed in as the account owner, and an API entry under Entegrasyonlar > API with the AnythingMCP redirect URL and permissions. About 5 minutes.

tools.name: ideasoft_list_orders
tools.description: List orders, newest first with sort -id: id, transactionId, status, paymentStatus, paymentTypeName, customer name, email and phone, amounts (amount, taxAmount, shippingAmount, finalAmount, currency), shipping provider, company and tracking code, createdAt and updatedAt. Read-only, up to 100 per page (a bare array).

payment_status.description: Payment status: success, in_transaction or failed.

start_created_at.description: Created on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_created_at.description: Created on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

start_shipping_date.description: Shipped on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

end_shipping_date.description: Shipped on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

member.description: Only orders of this member (customer) id.

cargo_tracking_code_non_existing.description: Only orders of this carrier without a tracking code yet.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100 (default 20). More than 100 answers 400.

sort.description: Sort: `id` ascending, `-id` descending (any sortable field, minus sign for descending).

since_id.description: Only records with an id above this one (incremental sync).

search.description: Keyword search over the searchable fields (s).

tools.name: ideasoft_get_order
tools.description: Read one order: customer, status and payment status, amounts and discounts, installments, shipping provider, company, payment type and tracking code, orderItems (productName, productSku, productBarcode, productPrice, productQuantity, productTax), shippingAddress and billingAddress (invoice type, tax number and office), member and dates.

tools.name: ideasoft_update_order
tools.description: Change an order: its status (being_prepared, fulfilled for shipped, delivered and so on) and, not confirmed by IdeaSoft's documentation, its shippingTrackingCode. Cancelling and refunding have their own switched-off tool, ideasoft_cancel_order. Only the fields given are sent.

shipping_tracking_code.description: Carrier tracking code. Whether IdeaSoft stores it through this call is not documented; check with ideasoft_get_order afterwards.

tools.name: ideasoft_cancel_order
tools.description: Set an order to cancelled or refunded. Cannot be undone from here and may trigger the refund of the payment and customer emails. Installed switched off.

tools.name: ideasoft_get_product
tools.description: Read one product with all fields: name, sku, barcode, stockAmount, price1, currency, discount, buyingPrice, tax, status, variants (children), brand, categories, prices, images, detail and SEO fields.

tools.name: ideasoft_create_product
tools.description: Create a product. IdeaSoft's schema marks many fields as required; the defaults here fill the switches (status 1, VAT included, discount type percent, unit Piece, no gift, shop shipping rules). Answers 201 with the product. Variants, images and long details are separate resources.

sku.description: Stock code (SKU), unique like an id.

price1.description: Main sales price (price1), in the product currency.

currency.description: Currency of the price: `{"id": 1}` with an id from ideasoft_list_currencies (1 is usually TL).

tax_included.description: 1: price1 includes VAT, 0: VAT is added.

discount.description: Discount value: a percentage when discount_type is 1, an amount when 0.

brand.description: Brand: `{"id": 5}` with an id from ideasoft_list_brands.

money_order_discount.description: Bank transfer (havale) discount in percent; 0 for none.

custom_shipping_disabled.description: 1: use the shop's shipping rules, 0: use custom_shipping_cost.

has_gift.description: 1: the product comes with a gift.

tools.name: ideasoft_update_product
tools.description: Change a product: stock (stock_amount), price (price1), status, name, VAT, discount and the other fields given; only those are sent. Whether IdeaSoft accepts a partial body is not documented: if it answers 400 or 422, read the product with ideasoft_get_product and send the fields it names.

sku.description: Stock code (SKU), unique like an id.

price1.description: Main sales price (price1), in the product currency.

currency.description: Currency of the price: `{"id": 1}` with an id from ideasoft_list_currencies (1 is usually TL).

tax_included.description: 1: price1 includes VAT, 0: VAT is added.

discount.description: Discount value: a percentage when discount_type is 1, an amount when 0.

brand.description: Brand: `{"id": 5}` with an id from ideasoft_list_brands.

tools.name: ideasoft_delete_product
tools.description: Delete a product with its variants and images. Cannot be undone; set status 0 with ideasoft_update_product to hide it instead. Installed switched off.

tools.name: ideasoft_list_product_prices
tools.description: List the extra price lists of products (price 2 to 6 next to the main price1): id, type, value and the product. Read-only.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100 (default 20). More than 100 answers 400.

tools.name: ideasoft_update_product_price
tools.description: Change one extra price of a product (types 2 to 6; the main price is price1 of ideasoft_update_product). Get the price id from ideasoft_list_product_prices.

tools.name: ideasoft_list_product_details
tools.description: List product details (the long HTML description and extra details) with sku and the product. Filter by product. Read-only.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100 (default 20). More than 100 answers 400.

tools.name: ideasoft_update_product_details
tools.description: Replace the long description (HTML) and extra details of a product. Get the detail id from ideasoft_list_product_details.

tools.description: Read one refund request with its items, reasons, amounts, the order and its status.

tools.description: List the shop's currencies: id, label, abbr (TL, USD, EUR and so on) and rate. The id is what currency of a product takes. Read-only.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1 to 100 (default 20). More than 100 answers 400.
